tool_args.rationale: Fit a sum of two saturating, gradient-sensitive fluxes numerically to the paid observations, then test it on fresh data. The available rows do not identify dependence on the other state variables or on horizon, so confirmation is necessary.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The acquired observations show a substantial dependence on s_grad.
The pilot response saturates with u_now rather than increasing linearly.
The acquired rows already vary both u_now and s_grad; fresh confirmation is the next discriminating test. The nuisance probe is irrelevant.
